name: Vegan "Cheeseburger" Salad with Veggie Ground, Tomato & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
6 tomatoes
0.68 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onions.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions, veggie ground, and spices; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place nutritional yeast, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, water, sugar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and cut crosswise into thin slices.
To serve, divide salad between bowls, then top with veggie ground and avocados. Enjoy!
